items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: Whose band was that? Lee Collins, Drew Rovershock. Or Albert Morton.

ctx.x: Did you ever play at La Vida? La Vida, I'm a boy out with me. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, I played at him.
Whose band was that? Lee Collins, Drew Rovershock. Or Albert Morton.
John Marrero. You don't know him? No, I just know Eddie and Lawrence. Huh? I knew Eddie and Lawrence Marrero, but not John, or Simon, or Billy.
